Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment Inspection list I1, which must be performed for water 
jet air pump every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title block .
The first draft initiated by eng. Medhat Fouad, 
tested at 27 May 2003, revised by EDEPC 
quality control eng. Abouda ElBana, accepted by General Manager eng. Ali Mostafa El-Lithy, and approved by 
eng. Mostafa Aalam Talkha PS Head Sector.
